The Curse of Plenty: The Green Revolution and the Rise in Chronic Disease
abstract: The rising rate of chronic disease is a leading driver of the global disease burden. Yet, its determinants are not fully understood. Exploiting the Green Revolution and its expansion in historically groundwater-rich Indian districts, we examine the unanticipated contribution of agricultural productivity growth to the rise in chronic, diet-related diseases. We find that areas with greater adoption of new staple varieties saw an increase in diabetes in men born after the introduction of high-yield crops. We find suggestive evidence that diet is an important mechanism, such as heterogeneous impacts with respect to dietary habits and increases in household calorie consumption. (JEL I12, O13, O15, O31, Q12, Q16)
abstract_zh: 慢性病发病率的上升是全球疾病负担的主要驱动因素。然而，其决定因素尚未被完全理解。利用绿色革命及其在历史上地下水丰富的印度地区的推广，我们考察了农业生产率增长对与饮食相关的慢性病上升所产生的意外影响。我们发现，新型主粮品种采用程度较高的地区，在高产作物引入后出生的男性中，糖尿病发病率有所上升。我们获得的初步证据表明，饮食是一个重要机制，例如存在与饮食习惯相关的异质性影响，以及家庭热量摄入的增加。（JEL分类号：I12，O13，O15，O31，Q12，Q16）

Water in Scarcity, Women in Peril
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: We provide evidence that groundwater scarcity results in an increase in sexual violence against women. Negative shocks, measured as the year-to-year variation in subsurface water from the long-term mean, result in an increase in reported rapes. We bolster our identification by providing insights from geology that explain why annual fluctuations in subsurface water are largely geogenic and hence exogenous. We posit that these negative shocks increase the time required for women to collect water from outside the house, thus exposing them to a heightened risk of violent attack. We find empirical support for this hypothesis and show evidence that makes alternative explanations untenable.
abstract_zh: 我们提供证据表明，地下水短缺会导致针对女性的性暴力增加。以地下水年际变化相对于长期均值的偏离来衡量的负向冲击，会使报告的强奸案件增加。我们借助地质学的见解加强了识别，解释了为何地下水年度波动在很大程度上由地质因素决定，因而是外生的。我们认为，这些负向冲击会增加女性从户外取水所需的时间，从而使其面临更高的遭受暴力袭击的风险。我们找到了支持这一假说的经验证据，并展示了可使其他解释难以成立的证据。

Wells, Water and Welfare: Impact of Access to Groundwater on Rural Poverty and Conflict
abstract: This paper evaluates the impact of access to groundwater on poverty using data from rural India. The estimation exploits the fact that the technology required to access groundwater changes exogenously due to constraints imposed by laws of physics at a depth of eight meters. I find that rural poverty in areas where depth from surface is below the cutoff is 9 to10 percent higher. Using survey data for a subsample of villages, I also show that disputes over irrigation water increase by 25 percent around the cutoff. Historical endowments of groundwater facilitate adoption of yield enhancing technologies over the long-run. (JEL D74, I32, O13, O15, O18, Q15, Q16)
abstract_zh: 本文利用印度农村数据，评估了获取地下水对贫困的影响。估计策略利用了如下事实：在八米深度处，受物理规律的约束，获取地下水所需的技术会发生外生变化。我发现，在地表至地下水位深度低于临界值的地区，农村贫困率高出9%至10%。利用部分村庄的调查数据，我还表明，围绕该临界值，关于灌溉用水的纠纷增加了25%。地下水的历史禀赋有利于长期内提高产量的技术的采用。（JEL分类号：D74，I32，O13，O15，O18，Q15，Q16）

title: Public Provision and Protection of Natural Resources: Groundwater Irrigation in Rural India
abstract: This paper evaluates the effects of a public groundwater provision program on water tables in Northern India. I theorize that public provision leads to sustainable use of groundwater when the fixed costs for private well provision are high. I use village-level longitudinal data on aquifers and wells, and exploit the physical and technological limitations of surface pumps that generate a cost difference at a specific water depth to test this model. My findings suggest that public provision can be used as an alternative in scenarios where prohibitive monitoring costs might preclude the use of other regulatory approaches to prevent over-extraction. (JEL O13, O18, Q15, Q25, Q28, Q53, Q58)
abstract_zh: 本文评估了一项公共地下水供应计划对印度北部地下水位的影响。我提出理论假说：当私人水井建设的固定成本较高时，公共供应将促使地下水得到可持续利用。我使用村庄层面关于含水层和水井的纵向数据，并利用地表水泵在特定水深处因物理和技术限制所产生的成本差异，对该模型进行检验。我的研究结果表明，在监测成本过高、可能妨碍采用其他监管手段防止过度抽取的情形下，公共供应可作为一种替代方案。（JEL分类号：O13，O18，Q15，Q25，Q28，Q53，Q58）
